url_homoglyphs.notes: The 't' in 'https' replaced by Cyrillic 'т' (U+0442) in SMS text to evade filters

indicators: URL uses Cyrillic homoglyph to bypass text-based URL filters
Use of popular URL shortener bit.ly to mask final destination
Suspicious domain xn--bank-secure-8q3a.com newly registered on 2024-04-25

examples.detection_method: Text normalization to detect homoglyph substitution in URLs; URL reputation engines to flag shortener redirects to suspicious domains; mobile gateway logging correlation for unusual SMS sender numbers; DNS anomaly detection for recent domain registrations with homoglyph characters.
